'''Faliar''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]], located in the [[Freeworlds Territory]] portion of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], within the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. Along with the rest of its [[Star system/Legends|star system]], Faliar was located on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] known as the [[Gandeal-Fondor Hyperlane]],<ref name="TEA" /> with a hyperlane also connecting it to the [[Sefon system/Legends|Sefon system]].<ref name="LotE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]]</ref> The planet occupied the first [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Fondor (star)|Fondor]] and had no [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. Faliar featured a [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] climate.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Faliar was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
